final_answer:
I found and fixed the client-side key-permissions problem: `id_ed25519` was mode `0644`, so SSH refused to use it. I changed it to `0600` without changing the key bytes.

I couldn’t verify access yet. Repeated failed attempts before the fix triggered SSH’s temporary connection penalty on the jump host (`server1`), and the later attempts were still rejected during that penalty. Both `server2` and `server4` remain unverified; retry after the penalty expires.
